text: ②じょうげで　たいせつなもの　を　えらび　「とうろく」　します。

structure.jp: たいせつなもの　を　えらび

patterns.name: 〜ます stem (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb with its ます cut off joins to the next action like 'and'; it is the written-style twin of the て-form. えらび = 'choose, and'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says that it is what you use to do the action. じょうげで = 'with Up and Down'.
